provenance.notes: Pinout, dimensions and ratings: Kingbright SC56-11EWA (0.56 in single digit, common cathode, right-hand decimal; spec DSAP6671 rev V.1A), page 1 package drawing and internal circuit (segments a=7, b=6, c=4, d=2, e=1, f=9, g=10, DP=5, common cathode on pins 3 and 8), electrical table and absolute maximums on page 2 (VF 1.9 V typical and 2.3 V maximum at 10 mA, DC IF 30 mA, peak IF 160 mA at 1/10 duty and 0.1 ms, VR 5 V). Body 12.7 x 19.05 mm (the 19.05 mm includes the 1.905 mm overhang past each pin row), 15.24 mm between the two pin rows (6 pitches), 8 mm thick, leads 0.5 mm diameter and 4 mm long; the drawing also shows a 6.8 mm dimension on the side view that is not interpreted here. Numbering runs counter-clockwise from pin 1 at the bottom left of the top view: pins 1 to 5 along the bottom, 6 to 10 back along the top. The two common pins (3 and 8) are one node in the internal circuit. Kit status: SunFounder page 1.1.4 states "In this kit, we use a Common Cathode display", and the component-list image shows "1 Dight 7-segment Display x1" whose body is marked CL5611AH. Conflicts and gaps: (1) the same page's C and Python code comments call its code table "common-anode ... a low bit turns a segment ON", yet its hex table sets a bit to light a segment (0x3F lights a-f) and its schematic ties the common pin to GND through 220 ohm with the 74HC595 outputs on the segment pins, which is common-cathode behavior; the text and schematic are followed. (2) No datasheet for the CL5611AH marking was found, and a retailer listing for a plain 5611AH calls it common anode; that listing is unverified and contradicts the kit documentation. The Kingbright part is used because its pin numbering matches the pin labels in the SunFounder schematic (top row g, f, common, a, b; bottom row e, d, common, c, dp; the schematic labels the bottom-left pin c twice, which is a typo for e). (3) VF and current ratings are Kingbright's high-efficiency-red chip; the kit part's chip data is not published.
